description:
## About the Event

Organized by **32BIT — Game Development Club of Siddaganga Institute of Technology (SIT), Tumakuru**, this one-day, offline event brings together students interested in gaming, programming, game design, and interactive experiences.

The event will begin with an engaging morning session featuring guest speakers, discussions, Q&A, and a practical game-development workshop. Participants will get an opportunity to learn from experienced individuals and explore the process of creating games.

In the afternoon, participants will take part in an open-format game-development hackathon. There is no fixed theme, so participants can build any type of game using their preferred game engine, programming language, and tools.

Participants can compete individually or form teams of up to six members. Games will be evaluated by judges, with prizes awarded to the top three entries.

Whether you are an experienced developer, an aspiring game designer, or someone curious about how games are made, this event is an opportunity to learn, experiment, collaborate, and turn ideas into playable experiences.

### Event Highlights
- Guest talks and interactive discussions
- Practical game-development workshop
- Open-theme game-development hackathon
- Freedom to use your preferred tools and technologies
- Solo participation or teams of up to six
- Prizes for the top three teams or entries
- Digital participation certificates

### Event Format
- **Mode:** Offline
- **Duration:** One day
- **Proposed timing:** 8:00 AM–7:00 PM
- **Organized by:** 32BIT — Game Development Club, SIT
- **Venue:** Birla Auditorium
- **Registration fee:** Free, subject to registration details and capacity

[https://32bit-sit.vercel.app/](url)

hackathon_faqs.answer: Any college student interested in gaming, game development, programming, design, or creativity can participate. Students from SIT and other colleges are welcome, subject to registration and available capacity.
hackathon_faqs.question: Who can participate in CODE ’N’ MOD?

hackathon_faqs.answer:
Absolutely! You don't need to know game development to be a part of CODE 'N' MOD!

In fact, this event is a great place to start. The morning sessions will introduce you to the world of game development through guest interactions, discussions, and a practical hands-on workshop.

You don't need to be an expert, know a particular programming language, or have developed a game before. All you need is curiosity, creativity, and a willingness to experiment.

You can participate individually or team up with others, learn something new, explore different tools, and try building your very first game.

Remember, you don't have to be a game developer to attend. You can come here to become one!

So don't let a lack of experience stop you. Every great game developer starts somewhere, and this could be your starting point.
hackathon_faqs.question: I don't know anything about game development. Can I still participate?

hackathon_faqs.answer:
Yes! You will receive a digital participation certificate from 32BIT after attending the event. You can use this certificate as proof of your participation and submit it to your college to get attendance for the event.

However, you must be physically present at the event and participate as required to be eligible for the certificate.

So don't worry about missing out on attendance! Come, learn something new, build games, and have a great experience with us!
